{{Quote|Retrieved Jori Daragon's amulet ''and'' the Eye of Horak-mul&hellip; amazing!|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Feln]], on Morne's accomplishments|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Eye of Horak-mul''' was a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] worn by [[Horak-mul]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the fall of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. A golden [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] replacement for Horak-mul's right [[Eye/Legends|eye]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> the Eye was fashioned for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sometime before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] at the [[Battle of Khar Delba]].<ref name="Tales 3" /> [[Celeste Morne]]&mdash;a [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]], or secret operative, of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sect known as the [[Jedi Covenant]]&mdash;later recovered the artifact sometime before [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eye of Horak-mul first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|third issue]] of the [[1996]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Tales 3" /> though the artifact was not named until a mention in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 25|twenty-fifth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] comic series in [[2008]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
